A's unresolved integration-specific issue is overlapping run_once generations. Pinned runner computes archive snapshot and handoff then atomically writes latest.json, audit_latest.json, anata_latest.json separately; archive writer locks cover append/load individually, not end-to-end handoff generation. The existing two-child spawn test runs A then append then B sequentially and therefore cannot witness an overlapping generation. Avoid claiming three-file atomic snapshot is a supported consumer requirement; test supported anata_latest.json causal retention instead.
